verdict.rationale: Typesense Cloud offers 'GPU Acceleration — Use GPUs for embedding generation', which implies embeddings are generated inside the engine rather than in a user-run pipeline. Self-host installs also mention optional GPU use, and semantic/hybrid search is documented and demoed. However, the evidence never explicitly describes auto-embedding fields, which models or providers are supported, or automatic query vectorization. Missing for 10: explicit docs on built-in or remote embedding models, automatic document and query vectorization at index and search time, supported providers, independent hands-on corroboration.
